description: Canonical Room 105 closet-woman composite asset and scene direction. The wooden door edge must occlude a substantial part of her head and neck: she is peeking through the opening, not pasted onto the door and not standing in front. Remove only the reference's surrounding black background, leaving a deep unlit closet behind her. Match dim warm room light and grain while keeping her unnaturally pale. Preserve all room pixels outside the closet area. No full body, hands, extra limbs, added gore, black rectangle, text, UI, or unrelated changes.
